difficulty_why: Linear allows any workspace admin to create a public OAuth app on a free account, and external customers can connect immediately with no platform review or user caps required.

dev_time.label: 15-30 min
dev_time.text: Covers creating a Linear workspace, setting up a Public OAuth application in workspace settings, and entering credentials into Composio.

launch_time.label: Same day
launch_time.text: Public OAuth applications can be authorized by any external Linear workspace immediately after creation without platform review or approval delays.

own_app_reasons.label: Custom branding on consent screen
own_app_reasons.text: Displays your product name, logo, developer name, and company URL directly on the Linear OAuth consent screen presented to connecting workspace members.

own_app_reasons.label: Custom scopes beyond default permissions
own_app_reasons.text: Enables requesting sensitive permissions like admin or timeSchedule:write if your agent requires workspace configuration or time management access.

own_app_reasons.label: App actor vs user actor control
own_app_reasons.text: Allows selecting between actor=user (acting on behalf of the individual user) and actor=app (acting as a workspace-level bot identity with workspace admin consent).

app_type.label: Public OAuth Application
app_type.text: Create a Public OAuth application. Linear apps default to Private (which restricts access exclusively to the creator workspace); setting distribution to Public allows external customers and workspaces to connect via OAuth 2.0.

prerequisites.label: Linear workspace account
prerequisites.text: A self-serve Linear account and workspace; free plans are fully supported and require no credit card.

prerequisites.label: Workspace admin role
prerequisites.text: You must hold the Workspace Admin role to access Settings > Administration > API and create OAuth applications.

prerequisites.label: Dedicated workspace recommended
prerequisites.text: Linear recommends creating a separate dedicated workspace to own the OAuth app so all team admins retain management access.

steps.label: Sign in or create workspace
steps.text: Sign in to Linear or create a free workspace with workspace admin privileges.

steps.label: Open OAuth application settings
steps.text: Open workspace settings and navigate to Settings > Administration > API > Applications, or navigate directly to the application creation form.

steps.label: Configure application details
steps.text: Fill in your application name and developer name, set distribution to Public so other workspaces can install it, and enter the Composio callback redirect URI. Scopes are omitted here because Linear configures them dynamically in authorization URLs.

steps.label: Save and copy credentials
steps.text: Create the application and copy the generated Client ID and Client Secret into Composio.

scopes.label: read
scopes.text: Read access to issues, comments, and workspace data for the authorized account.

scopes.label: write
scopes.text: Write access allowing modification of workspace entities permitted by the user's role.

scopes.label: issues:create
scopes.text: Allows creating and updating Linear issues and issue attachments.

scopes.label: comments:create
scopes.text: Allows creating new comments on Linear issues.

approval.label: When required
approval.text: Platform review is not required for external workspaces to install and authorize a public OAuth application; review is only required if you want your app listed in the public Linear Integration Directory.

approval.label: What's checked
approval.text: For directory listing, Linear reviews utility to users, verifies that the developer is a formal company rather than an individual hobbyist, and checks required 320x320 icons and 1600x1000 showcase assets.

approval.label: Wait
approval.text: No published review turnaround time or SLA is specified by Linear for directory submissions.

approval.label: Cost
approval.text: Free; Linear charges no fee for OAuth application registration, API usage, or integration directory review.

approval.label: Common rejections
approval.text: Linear rejects directory submissions that are scripts, low-effort tools, unbranded hobbyist projects, or applications that fail asset formatting specifications.

approval.label: Before approval
approval.text: Any workspace can connect to the public OAuth app immediately without test-user restrictions or verification gates.

approval.label: Install cap before review
approval.text: None. Linear does not impose an install cap or limit on how many workspaces can connect to an unreviewed public OAuth application.

approval.label: Limits until reviewed
approval.text: Standard rate limits apply (5,000 requests and 2,000,000 complexity points per hour per user); unreviewed apps are not subjected to reduced API rate limits.

pitfalls.label: Distribution defaults to private
pitfalls.text: Linear OAuth applications default to Private distribution upon creation; you must explicitly set distribution to Public for other workspaces to authorize the app.

pitfalls.label: Scopes configured in authorize URL, not console
pitfalls.text: Linear does not configure OAuth scopes in the application settings UI; scopes must be passed dynamically in the authorization request URL by Composio.

pitfalls.label: Short-lived tokens and refresh token rotation
pitfalls.text: Access tokens expire after 24 hours (86,399 seconds), and refresh tokens rotate on each exchange with a 30-minute replay grace period.

pitfalls.label: Customer workspace third-party app approvals
pitfalls.text: Customer workspaces on paid plans can restrict installations, requiring an admin in the customer's workspace to approve the application before members can connect.

pitfalls.label: Application naming constraints
pitfalls.text: Application names must be between 2 and 80 characters long and cannot include the words 'Linear', 'http://', or 'https://'.

pitfalls.label: Exact redirect URI match
pitfalls.text: The redirect URI specified in authorization requests must match one of the registered URIs (up to 32 supported) exactly.

support.label: Linear Slack Community #api channel
support.text: Join Linear's official Slack community and ask questions in the #api channel.

support.label: Integration Directory Support
support.text: Contact integrations@linear.app for inquiries regarding public directory listings and showcase requirements.

support.label: Linear Developer Documentation
support.text: Official developer documentation covering OAuth 2.0 authentication, scopes, and app manifests.

email_subject: Linear OAuth Integration & Directory Guidelines - [Your Product Name]
email_body:
Hi Linear Developer Support Team,

We are developing an AI agent integration ([Your Product Name]) that connects with Linear via OAuth 2.0 to manage issues and comments on behalf of our users.

Our integration requests the following scopes: read, write, issues:create, and comments:create. We have configured our application with distribution set to Public and callback URL [https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add].

Could you please confirm:
1. Are there any restrictions or install limits for public OAuth applications that are unlisted and not submitted to the Integration Directory?
2. If we later decide to submit [Your Product Name] to the Linear Integration Directory, what is the current expected review turnaround time and review checklist?

Thank you,
[Your Name]
[Your Company / Organization]
[Contact Information]

checks.text: Composio has a toolkit for Linear (`linear`); Composio-managed OAuth app: yes; auth methods: OAUTH2, API_KEY

checks.text: Authorize URL is live (it renders a page; we couldn't confirm how it treats unknown apps)

observed.label: Self-serve signup form
observed.text: The Linear signup page (linear.app/signup) is self-serve and presents options to sign up using Google or an email address, without asking for a credit card.

observed.label: Free tier availability
observed.text: The pricing page shows a Free plan ($0/month) that can be started self-serve without requiring payment credentials.

observed.label: OAuth app creation login wall
observed.text: Navigating directly to the OAuth app creation page (linear.app/settings/api/applications/new) redirects unauthenticated visitors to a login wall with Google, email, and SAML options.

observed.label: OAuth documentation access
observed.text: The OAuth documentation path (linear.app/docs/oauth) redirects and renders public developer documentation explaining OAuth 2.0 authentication and app manifests.
